{"version":"2b1","blocks":[{"type":"text","text":"The dot product of two vectors measures how much one vector extends in the direction of another. It is calculated as the product of their lengths and the cosine of the angle between them."},{"type":"ui","source":"root = Stack([definition,angleControl,projection,orthogonality,graphic])
$angle = 60
definition = Text("The dot product of vectors a and b is |a||b|cos(θ), where θ is the angle between them.")
angleControl = Control("Angle θ (degrees)", 0, 180, [], $angle)
projection = Text($angle == 90 ? "The projection is zero: the vectors are orthogonal." : ($angle < 90 ? "The projection is positive: vectors point in similar directions." : "The projection is negative: vectors point in opposite directions."))
orthogonality = Text($angle == 90 ? "Vectors are orthogonal (perpendicular)." : "Vectors are not orthogonal.")
graphic = Graphic("Vector Dot Product Diagram", [group([
  path("M 60 100 L 180 100"),
  text(180, 110, "a"),
  path("M 60 100 L " + (60 + 100 * cos($angle * 3.1416 / 180)) + " " + (100 - 100 * sin($angle * 3.1416 / 180))),
  text(60 + 110 * cos($angle * 3.1416 / 180), 100 - 110 * sin($angle * 3.1416 / 180), "b"),
  path("M 180 100 L " + (60 + 100 * cos($angle * 3.1416 / 180)) + " " + (100 - 100 * sin($angle * 3.1416 / 180))),
  text(120, 90, "θ = " + $angle + "°")
])])
","state":[{"name":"angle","value":60}]}]}

$angle = 60
definition = Text("Dot product: |a||b|cos(θ), where θ is the angle between vectors a and b.")
angleControl = Control("Angle θ (degrees)", 0, 180, [], $angle)
projection = Text($angle == 90 ? "Projection is zero: vectors are orthogonal." : ($angle < 90 ? "Projection is positive: vectors point in similar directions." : "Projection is negative: vectors point in opposite directions."))
orthogonality = Text($angle == 90 ? "Vectors are orthogonal (perpendicular)." : "Vectors are not orthogonal.")
diagram = Graphic("Dot Product Diagram", [
  path("M 60 100 L 180 100"),
  text(185, 105, "a"),
  path("M 60 100 L " + (60 + 100 * cos($angle * 3.1416 / 180)) + " " + (100 - 100 * sin($angle * 3.1416 / 180))),
  text(60 + 110 * cos($angle * 3.1416 / 180), 100 - 110 * sin($angle * 3.1416 / 180), "b"),
  path("M 180 100 L " + (60 + 100 * cos($angle * 3.1416 / 180)) + " " + (100 - 100 * sin($angle * 3.1416 / 180))),
  text(120, 90, "θ = " + $angle + "°")
])
","state":[{"name":"angle","value":60}]}]}
